summary: Veritone, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting a registered direct offering of 20,000,000 common shares to named purchasers under a September 30, 2026 securities purchase agreement. The offering used the company's effective Form S-3 shelf (No. 333-280148). No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date appears in the excerpt. Cooley LLP supplied the legality opinion. Mechanics involve shelf takedown and share overhang from new issuance; watch dilution and pricing terms.
